items.title: Langtang Valley trek reopens
items.summary: Rasuwa, October 29 The Langtang Valley trekking route has reopened following the construction of alternative trails. Although the Bhotekoshi flood damaged the Pasang Lhamu Highway and infrastructure in the Syabrubesi area, new trekking routes have been opened to ensure the safety of trekkers.
